author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a boxer with a round head over an upright torso throws a straight punch, the round glove stopping short of a tall capsule punching bag hung on a chain; the back leg is extended and the front knee bent, as in the reference. The rejected drawing had a tiny head on a slanted torso and the fist merged into the bag. Human spacing: the head r4 at (10,10) is exactly 8 above the neck (10,22), vertical and certified.
omissions: The reference's forward lean is drawn with an upright torso so that the head gap certifies; the glove is a round r3 ring.
